items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: we were playing mostly Dizzy’s, maybe entirely Dizzy’s arrangements, his old big band arrangements. And we had an extensive rehearsal with him.

ctx.x: He certainly had that knack of making people feel good.

Yeah. And also the other thing that was exciting about that was we were playing mostly Dizzy’s, maybe entirely Dizzy’s arrangements, his old big band arrangements. And we had an extensive rehearsal with him. And having him show us how these compositions were meant to be played was really enlightening and fun. He was serious about it. He did joke around a lot, but he was serious about the music. He was especially hard on the drummer I’ll say, who was a good drummer, but there was a lot of stuff that you don’t…
Seems like I read somewhere that he even taught Art Blakey to play drums or something.
